baseline_observations: index-START.html has an empty <script> block and does not implement the click-and-drag interaction.
The page has no feature-detection or fallback mechanism for environments or assistive devices where mouse dragging is unsupported or disabled.
There were no explicit fallback controls (such as step buttons or status banners) to allow accessible navigation when drag events are unavailable.
decision: Implement the click-and-drag interaction in index-START.html. Add accessible scroll fallback controls (prev/next buttons) and a feature-status fallback banner that explicitly communicates when mouse dragging is unsupported, testing both feature-present (drag mousemove) and feature-absent (unsupported stub with button fallback) paths.
